The area where the project will discharge is the relatively shallow cove of the Whitewater River. The diversity of fish and aquatic life is greater in such shallow areas. Fish spawn in these areas and their offspring use these regions as nursery areas. Prior to spawning migrations into tributaries, several species of cold water fishes concentrate in these areas awaiting optimal conditions for spawning runs. These shallow areas are normally more productive than deepwater due to more diverse substrates and more stable conditions due to lessened wave action and wind.
